title: Disputing the Final Inspection of a Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease Vehicle
content:
**Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease — disputes of the final turn-in inspection**

**How a dispute is made.** The lessee disputes the final inspection by completing an inspection dispute request.

**Time limit.** A dispute must be filed no later than 14 calendar days (the dispute period in every tier) after the turn-in inspection was performed. The period is counted in calendar days starting the day after the final inspection's inspection date, and a dispute filed on the last day is timely. The inspection date on the inspection report is the anchor.

| Final inspection date (hypothetical) | Last day to file | Filed on | Timely |
|---|---|---|---|
| May 10 | May 24 | May 24 | yes |
| May 10 | May 24 | May 25 | no |

**One adjustment per item.** Each assessed wear item may be adjusted only once.

**Outcomes of a dispute**

| What the lessee shows | Outcome for the item |
|---|---|
| A repair invoice from a licensed repair facility, dated on or before the turn-in date, covering that item's category and location | the item is removed on dispute |
| That the item was recorded under the wrong category | the item is reduced on dispute to the schedule charge of the correct category |
| Photos, opinions, or repairs made after the turn-in date | the item does not change |

An adjustment never adds a new item.

**Hypothetical illustrations**

- A dent on the rear door is shown repaired by an invoice from a licensed body shop dated two days before the turn-in date, covering a body dent on the rear door: the item is removed on dispute.
- The same invoice is dated one day after the turn-in date: the item does not change.
- An item recorded as a damaged wheel is shown to be a tire: it is reduced on dispute to the tire charge.
